title: A Trip to the Countryside
description: Three short recordings about a trip to a farm: in the car, on the farm and a talk to the class.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · In the car
parts.intro: You will hear Lily talking to her dad in the car.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Dad, how long until we get to the farm?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: About twenty minutes. Look out of the window. Can you see the river?

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Yes! And there are some cows in the field.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Those are Grandpa's cows. He has twelve of them.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Will we see the sheep too?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Yes, but they're on the hill. We'll walk up there after lunch.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: I hope it doesn't rain.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Look at the big blue sky. I think the weather will be lovely all day.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Yes! I can't wait to see Grandpa again, and I want to run in the fields.

parts.title: Part 2 · On the farm
parts.intro: You will hear Lily and her grandpa on the farm.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Welcome, Lily! Would you like to feed the chickens?

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Yes, please! What do they eat?

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Corn. Throw it on the ground, like this. But be careful of the big white one. He's a bit noisy.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: He's funny. Can I look for eggs?

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Yes. Look in the barn, behind the hay. We usually find about six eggs each morning.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: I found four! Oh, wait, here's another. That's five!

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Wonderful! We'll have them for lunch with bread.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Grandpa, your farm is so nice. I wish I lived here and had a dog.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Maybe one day, Lily. Now wash your hands, please, and we'll cook.

parts.title: Part 3 · Lily's talk
parts.intro: You will hear Lily talking to her class about her weekend.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Last weekend, I went to my grandpa's farm. It was great. In the morning, I fed the chickens and found some eggs.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: After lunch, we walked up the hill to see the sheep. It was a long walk, but I could see the whole valley from the top.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Then I rode on Grandpa's old tractor. It was very loud!

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: In the evening, we had a picnic by the river and watched the sunset.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Next time, I want to stay for the whole weekend.
